verdicts.reason: A is just the original column shrunk down. The bottle is tiny, the SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline, and the headline, wordmark, two-line body copy and CTA are jammed together in the lower half with almost no gaps, so the ~9px body copy is barely readable. B rebuilds it as a proper two-column layout for the wide format, with a large, readable bottle on the left and the copy on the right, but SOLSTICE is blown up almost to headline size and competes with it, 'fizz' sits alone on the second headline line, the brand still comes after the headline, and the small body copy sits over the green circle.
